name: com.danielnoam.buildtool
description:
A build window for releasing: builds Android APK and Windows targets from Build Profiles one after another, runs the project's own checks, signs Android releases with a keystore kept off the repository, and uploads to a folder, GitHub Releases, itch.io (butler) and Steam (SteamPipe).

Editor-only. Project setup lives in Assets/Settings/Build/BuildConfig.asset; per-machine folders, keys and logins stay on each computer.
